minDenominatorNote: No minimum beyond a positive all-housing-units denominator; small counties can have wide ACS margins of error.

indicators.label: Owner-occupied homes
indicators.description: Share of all housing units that are owner-occupied.
indicators.method: Owner-occupied housing units divided by all housing units, times 100. Chugach Census Area (02063) and Copper River Census Area (02066) are combined into the 2017 Valdez-Cordova Census Area (02261) boundary; the union differs from the 2017 boundary by 0.004% of area (a coastal/glacier sliver). Counts are summed; the share is computed from the summed numerator and denominator.

indicators.label: Renter-occupied homes
indicators.description: Share of all housing units that are renter-occupied.
indicators.method: Renter-occupied housing units divided by all housing units, times 100. Chugach Census Area (02063) and Copper River Census Area (02066) are combined into the 2017 Valdez-Cordova Census Area (02261) boundary; the union differs from the 2017 boundary by 0.004% of area (a coastal/glacier sliver). Counts are summed; the share is computed from the summed numerator and denominator.

indicators.label: Vacant homes
indicators.description: Share of all housing units that are vacant, including seasonal and occasional-use units.
indicators.method: Vacant housing units divided by all housing units, times 100. Chugach Census Area (02063) and Copper River Census Area (02066) are combined into the 2017 Valdez-Cordova Census Area (02261) boundary; the union differs from the 2017 boundary by 0.004% of area (a coastal/glacier sliver). Counts are summed; the share is computed from the summed numerator and denominator.

legacy.label: Homeownership rate (occupied households)
legacy.note: The former occupied-household rate is not part of this three-indicator set.

caveats: The denominator is all housing units, occupied plus vacant, including seasonal and occasional-use units.
Vacant includes seasonal, recreational, and occasional-use units, so a high vacant share is not by itself a measure of available housing.
Shares are computed from unrounded counts; values displayed to one decimal may not sum exactly to 100.0.
Later ACS releases no longer publish the eight 2017 Connecticut counties used by the 2017 boundary set.
